title: Recognise and reduce salt buildup
summary: Manage crusting and plant stress in containers or irrigated soil without guessing.
steps: Look for white crust, burned leaf edges, stunted growth and repeated wilting despite moist soil.
Check drainage first and review fertiliser dose and irrigation-water quality.
Stop unnecessary fertiliser and remove visible surface deposits without damaging roots.
Where drainage and water quality permit, leach containers thoroughly and let them drain completely.
Replace severely degraded mix and seek a water or soil test when the problem returns.
